### Asana Plans & Pricing (per user, per month)

- **Personal** (Free forever):
	- **Cost:** $0 (supports up to 2 users)
	- **Features:** Unlimited tasks and projects, list/board/calendar views, and 100MB file storage limit.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXXGpnoilga2kL_vOU2aeeRV_O_hv9wVEuMJpVB57eswjjmGXjSuWKoIEfNFouq5pqfNcl68HaqftZ4VvaBbbXsM2fFIAFUcOhcnpCLAtfNntDe)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXxcG-r314z78Ik7ofUY6nrMCNzA7eMnbjt3R7y1jFVfCXFADasHLair_995gjeLEU5J9R1Xvr56LyK6e3V5uUWTCV_be4iDw2aGdX9YiDxm1S6gyfRThga-oUD41EcQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXVS3QcEmtOXOtWqfCtR371aSMpLWA7ZBMjfRhCs4L1wX_Zkg9dYdLbDuMy9YC5DDr98lPH__bnm-6n0JoBmXmXJeeV8r4Xh3OLQtCu-Fmux1xDU0dSgyCjxC7iFdA1NMuwuHB0i1yRQS8fz8E)
- **Starter**:
	- **Cost:** **$10.99 per user/month** (billed annually) or **$13.49 per user/month** (billed monthly).
	- **Features:** Timeline and Gantt views, custom fields, unlimited automations, and AI Studio basic credits.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXVS3QcEmtOXOtWqfCtR371aSMpLWA7ZBMjfRhCs4L1wX_Zkg9dYdLbDuMy9YC5DDr98lPH__bnm-6n0JoBmXmXJeeV8r4Xh3OLQtCu-Fmux1xDU0dSgyCjxC7iFdA1NMuwuHB0i1yRQS8fz8E)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXYQVkZW21LWGzYfa4-82emlYbB1l3O-2ta5aqGJmixrW2n3GpiP6pELYKosaP8hdQVq9hHfhLr2DCgLBgHVv5A54rn7KH4tMUIhXX1yoeomFnKlyJV5cYhPwEFSngZ14)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXXGpnoilga2kL_vOU2aeeRV_O_hv9wVEuMJpVB57eswjjmGXjSuWKoIEfNFouq5pqfNcl68HaqftZ4VvaBbbXsM2fFIAFUcOhcnpCLAtfNntDe)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXgmnyGkaq8CMaEoFn8rwzMetY7a31VmrSySFtIU5MpHFTZVRK-0d6RyMkIwwRZ5QkWS9GsAfRsETGy01jnjOP2irSPfUuuPaE8VIVMU015WdA_3Q6L1EBzB0a7r3oAnMO)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX03sxtlveEgnEpmNyIC6cRKHINsQhLp619GL63pU3D6gBOfbkpwX-BKuDf8GbXopeJj6za0ZoiBUZZuE3NUuvhCvUrWQsCPknwVdNoQmjbwB3CMuu7fuUdz_tJuVDBFj0pP13L5Fb7Dk)
- **Advanced**:
	- **Cost:** **$24.99 per user/month** (billed annually) or **$30.49 per user/month** (billed monthly).
	- **Features:** Portfolios, goals, resource management, AI meetings, and expanded AI Studio credits.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXXGpnoilga2kL_vOU2aeeRV_O_hv9wVEuMJpVB57eswjjmGXjSuWKoIEfNFouq5pqfNcl68HaqftZ4VvaBbbXsM2fFIAFUcOhcnpCLAtfNntDe)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXYQVkZW21LWGzYfa4-82emlYbB1l3O-2ta5aqGJmixrW2n3GpiP6pELYKosaP8hdQVq9hHfhLr2DCgLBgHVv5A54rn7KH4tMUIhXX1yoeomFnKlyJV5cYhPwEFSngZ14)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXgmnyGkaq8CMaEoFn8rwzMetY7a31VmrSySFtIU5MpHFTZVRK-0d6RyMkIwwRZ5QkWS9GsAfRsETGy01jnjOP2irSPfUuuPaE8VIVMU015WdA_3Q6L1EBzB0a7r3oAnMO)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX03sxtlveEgnEpmNyIC6cRKHINsQhLp619GL63pU3D6gBOfbkpwX-BKuDf8GbXopeJj6za0ZoiBUZZuE3NUuvhCvUrWQsCPknwVdNoQmjbwB3CMuu7fuUdz_tJuVDBFj0pP13L5Fb7Dk)
- **Enterprise & Enterprise Plus**:
	- **Cost:** Custom pricing (contact sales).
	- **Features:** SAML, SCIM, advanced admin controls, HIPAA compliance, and data residency options.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXXGpnoilga2kL_vOU2aeeRV_O_hv9wVEuMJpVB57eswjjmGXjSuWKoIEfNFouq5pqfNcl68HaqftZ4VvaBbbXsM2fFIAFUcOhcnpCLAtfNntDe)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXYQVkZW21LWGzYfa4-82emlYbB1l3O-2ta5aqGJmixrW2n3GpiP6pELYKosaP8hdQVq9hHfhLr2DCgLBgHVv5A54rn7KH4tMUIhXX1yoeomFnKlyJV5cYhPwEFSngZ14)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX03sxtlveEgnEpmNyIC6cRKHINsQhLp619GL63pU3D6gBOfbkpwX-BKuDf8GbXopeJj6za0ZoiBUZZuE3NUuvhCvUrWQsCPknwVdNoQmjbwB3CMuu7fuUdz_tJuVDBFj0pP13L5Fb7Dk)

- **Timesheets and Budgets:** $5.99 per user/month (billed annually)
- **AI Credits / Studio Add-ons:** Prepaid and pay-as-you-go credit options available beyond the basic included caps.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXXGpnoilga2kL_vOU2aeeRV_O_hv9wVEuMJpVB57eswjjmGXjSuWKoIEfNFouq5pqfNcl68HaqftZ4VvaBbbXsM2fFIAFUcOhcnpCLAtfNntDe)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXgmnyGkaq8CMaEoFn8rwzMetY7a31VmrSySFtIU5MpHFTZVRK-0d6RyMkIwwRZ5QkWS9GsAfRsETGy01jnjOP2irSPfUuuPaE8VIVMU015WdA_3Q6L1EBzB0a7r3oAnMO)
